slides.heading: else Statements
slides.body: else Statements is part of Conditional Execution. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: else Statements
slides.body: An else block runs when the if condition is False. It gives the program a backup path.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: else is like having Plan B. If Plan A does not happen, Plan B is followed.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A conditional needs a colon, correct indentation, and a condition that clearly evaluates to True or False.
